text:
Ava: Heads-up from QA — opening the settings modal while a toast is visible causes the modal header to shift down ~12px. Repro steps: open console, trigger "Saved" toast, click Settings. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/modal-shift.png
Noah: Saw that too. Toast currently flows in document and pushes everything. That explains the tab-focus jumping.
Priya: Accessibility concern: when focus lands on the modal close button it briefly appears in a different place because of the layout shift. Screen reader users could lose context.
Ava: Proposed approach: make toasts fixed-position and layered underneath modals (modal z-index > toast). Also ensure toasts are non-interactive (pointer-events: none) except when hovered.
Liam: CSS sketch I used in a quick prototype:
```css
.toast { position: fixed; top: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px); opacity: 0; animation: enter .16s forwards; pointer-events: auto; }
.modal { z-index: 1100; }
.toast--hidden { pointer-events: none; }
```
Priya: pointer-events: none on toasts by default is good for keyboard users. Make sure toast announcements still fire for SR users (aria-live region).
Noah: microcopy note: our toast text says "Saved" in some places and "Changes saved" in others. Recommend consistent phrasing: "Changes saved" for clarity.
Ava: Also spotted toolbar spacing feels cramped when the toast appears. The toolbar uses --space-1 between icon buttons. Can we bump to --space-2 in the toolbar only?
Liam: Prefer adding a component-level override rather than changing token globally. We'll introduce --toolbar-gap as a token mapped to 8px for now. If we find other places that need it we can promote it later.
Priya: Focus styling: icon-only buttons need a stronger focus ring. Current ring is subtle on light mode. Suggest using 2px solid with --color-focus and ensure outline-offset is 2px for visibility. Also add aria-labels to any icon buttons missing them.
Noah: QA will add an E2E: trigger toast, open modal, assert document.activeElement stays on expected element and assert no layout shift >6px on header.
Ava: Can someone add a short note in DESIGN_TOKENS.md about z-index ordering (toasts < modals < overlays) so future folks don't pick random numbers?
Liam: Will add comment and update component docs. Also I'll include reduced-height mobile toast variant (max-height: 48px) and faster timeout on narrow viewports.
Priya: For SRs: keep aria-live polite for toasts that aren't critical, assert that the modal receives initial focus after open (focus trap).
Ava: Thanks — I'm making a small PR that: 1) moves toast to fixed layer with transform animations, 2) adds --toolbar-gap token and updates toolbar, 3) stronger focus ring and aria-label audit, 4) microcopy unify to "Changes saved".
design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#512 — "toasts: fixed layer + toolbar gap + focus & copy tweaks" (assigned to Ava)
Noah: I'll run the keyboard focus E2E and snapshot toolbar visuals post-change.
Priya: I'll spot-check with VoiceOver and NVDA once PR is up.
Ava: Linking PR here when it's ready. Appreciate quick reviews so QA can verify today :rocket:
